1/8-inch thick double metal jacketed gasket per ASME B16.20 with elastomeric-bound filler material and 0.015 inch minimum thick jacket. Metal jacketing material should be as follows:
- Fresh & salt water: Copper or brass
- Sour water: AISI Type 316L SS
All services, except chemical oxidizers, -20°F to 1500°F

3/32 inch thick double metal jacketed gasket per ASME B16.20 with flexible graphite filler material and 0.015 inch minimum thick jacket. Flexible graphite filler specifications shall be as follows:
- Density (nominal): 70 lbs/ft² ± 10 lbs/ft²
- Carbon content: 95 wt% min.
- Leachable chlorides: 100 ppm max.
- Total sulfur: 1000 ppm max.
- Fillers or binders: none
Metal jacketing material shall be as follows:
- Hydrofluoric acid: Monel 400
- Hydrochloric acid: Hastelloy C
- Clad and/or weld overlay vessels: Same material as cladding and/or overlay
- Hydrogen with H₂S at 450–700°F: AISI Types 304L, 316L, 321 or 347 SS
- Hydrogen with naphthenic acid at all temperatures: AISI Type 316L, 317L SS
- Remaining general services exceeding 700°F: AISI Types 304L, 316L, 321, 347 SS
- Remaining general services up to and including 700°F: AISI Type 410S or 304L, 316L, 321, 347 SS
Note: Carbon steel can be used if the expected corrosion allowance is less than or equal to 0.010 inch over the gasket's expected life.
Chemical oxidizers (e.g. sulfuric, nitric, phosphoric acids)

3/32 inch thick double metal jacketed gasket per API 601 with PTFE (Teflon) filler material and 0.015 inch minimum thick jacket. Metal jacketing shall be as follows:
- Sulfuric acid: Alloy 20
- Nitric acid: AISI Type 304 SS, use Type 304L SS for welded construction
- Phosphoric acid: AISI Type 316 SS, use Type 31 6L SS for welded construction
